079/**
080 * Represents an HTTP request for a REST resource.
081 *
082 * <p>
083 *    The {@link RestRequest} object is an extension of the <l>HttpServletRequest</l> class
084 *    with various built-in convenience methods for use in building REST interfaces.
085 *    It can be accessed by passing it as a parameter on your REST Java method:
086 * </p>
087 *
088 * <p class='bjava'>
089 *    <ja>@RestPost</ja>(...)
090 *    <jk>public</jk> Object myMethod(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>) {...}
091 * </p>
092 *
093 * <p>
094 *    The primary methods on this class are:
095 * </p>
096 * <ul class='javatree'>
097 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RestRequest}
098 *    <ul class='spaced-list'>
099 *       <li>Methods for accessing the request content:
100 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
101 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getContent() getContent()}
102 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getInputStream() getInputStream()}
103 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getReader() getReader()}
104 *       </ul>
105 *       <li>Methods for accessing HTTP parts:
106 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
107 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#checkPreconditions(RestResponse) checkPreconditions(RestResponse)}
108 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#containsFormParam(String) containsFormParam(String)}
109 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#containsHeader(String) containsHeader(String)}
110 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#containsQueryParam(String) containsQueryParam(String)}
111 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHeader(Class) getHeader(Class)}
112 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHeader(String) getHeader(String)}
113 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHeaders() getHeaders()}
114 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getFormParam(Class) getFormParam(Class)}
115 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getFormParam(String) getFormParam(String)}
116 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getFormParams() getFormParams()}
117 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathParam(Class) getPathParam(Class)}
118 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathParam(String) getPathParam(String)}
119 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathParams() getPathParams()}
120 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathRemainder() getPathRemainder()}
121 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryParam(Class) getQueryParam(Class)}
122 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryParam(String) getQueryParam(String)}
123 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryParams() getQueryParams()}
124 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryString() getQueryString()}
125 *       </ul>
126 *       <li>Methods for localization:
127 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
128 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getLocale() getLocale()}
129 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMessage(String,Object...) getMessage(String,Object...)}
130 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMessages() getMessages()}
131 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getTimeZone() getTimeZone()}
132 *       </ul>
133 *       <li>Methods for accessing static files:
134 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
135 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getVarResolverSession() getVarResolverSession()}
136 *       </ul>
137 *       <li>Methods for assertions:
138 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
139 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertContent() assertContent()}
140 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertCharset() assertCharset()}
141 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertFormParam(String) assertFormParam(String)}
142 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertHeader(String) assertHeader(String)}
143 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertQueryParam(String) assertQueryParam(String)}
144 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertRequestLine() assertRequestLine()}
145 *       </ul>
146 *       <li>Other:
147 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
148 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getAttribute(String) getAttribute(String)}
149 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getAttributes() getAttributes()}
150 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getAuthorityPath() getAuthorityPath()}
151 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMarshallingSession() getMarshallingSession()}
152 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getCharset() getCharset()}
153 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getConfig() getConfig()}
154 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getContext() getContext()}
155 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getContextPath() getContextPath()}
156 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHttpServletRequest() getHttpServletRequest()}
157 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMethod() getMethod()}
158 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getOpContext() getOpContext()}
159 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getOperationSwagger() getOperationSwagger()}
160 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPartParserSession() getPartParserSession()}
161 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPartSerializerSession() getPartSerializerSession()}
162 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathInfo() getPathInfo()}
163 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getProtocolVersion() getProtocolVersion()}
164 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequest(Class) getRequest(Class)}
165 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequestLine() getRequestLine()}
166 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequestURI() getRequestURI()}
167 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequestURL() getRequestURL()}
168 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getServletPath() getServletPath()}
169 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getSession() getSession()}
170 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getSwagger() getSwagger()}
171 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getUriContext() getUriContext()}
172 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getUriResolver() getUriResolver()}
173 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isDebug() isDebug()}
174 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isPlainText() isPlainText()}
175 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isUserInRole(String) isUserInRole(String)}
176 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setAttribute(String,Object) setAttribute(String,Object)}
177 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setCharset(Charset) setCharset(Charset)}
178 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setDebug() setDebug()}
179 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setException(Throwable) setException(Throwable)}
180 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setNoTrace() setNoTrace()}
181 *       </ul>
182 *    </ul>
183 * </ul>
184 *
185 */
186@SuppressWarnings({
187   "unchecked", // Type erasure requires unchecked casts in REST client operations
188   "unused", // Unused parameters in HttpServletRequest overrides and helper methods
189   "java:S6539", // Collection.toArray() usage intentional
190   "resource", // Streams returned to servlet container; lifecycle managed by the container
191   "javabugs:S2259" // Null accesses are guarded by nn() checks; Sonar's flow analysis does not track nn() as a null guard
192})
193public class RestRequest extends HttpServletRequestWrapper {

195   /**
196    * Request-attribute name under which the per-response Content-Security-Policy nonce is cached.
197    *
198    * <p>
199    * Set by {@link RestResponse} when an emitted CSP header contains a nonce placeholder, and read by the
200    * serialization layer (to stamp the matching {@code nonce="..."} on inline {@code <script>}/{@code <style>} tags)
201    * so the header and the markup share the same nonce.
202    */
203   public static final String CSP_NONCE_ATTR = "CspNonce";
204
205   /**
206    * Returns {@code true} if {@code method} is one of the methods the {@code content} URL-parameter body
207    * override (see {@link Rest#disableContentParam()}) is documented to apply to.
208    *
209    * <p>
210    * Package-private for direct unit-test coverage. Restricting the override to {@code PUT}/{@code POST} (its
211    * documented scope all along) keeps a plain cross-origin {@code GET} &mdash; the kind a browser will issue
212    * with no preflight and no custom header for something as simple as an <code>&lt;img src=...&gt;</code> tag
213    * &mdash; from ever having its body-carrying {@code Content-Type} gate bypassed via a query string, without
214    * touching the {@link Rest#disableContentParam()} default itself.
215    *
216    * @param method The request's HTTP method. Can be {@code null} (returns {@code false}).
217    * @return {@code true} if {@code method} is {@code PUT} or {@code POST}, case-insensitively.
218    */
219   static boolean isContentParamMethod(String method) {
220      return "PUT".equalsIgnoreCase(method) || "POST".equalsIgnoreCase(method);
221   }
222
223   /*
224    * Converts an Accept-Language value entry to a Locale.
225    */
226   @SuppressWarnings({
227      "java:S1874" // The new Locale(String,String) constructor is not deprecated on the Java 17 baseline; its replacement Locale.of(...) was only added in Java 19.
228   })
229   private static Locale toLocale(String lang) {
230      var country = "";
231      var i = lang.indexOf('-');
232      if (i > -1) {
233         country = lang.substring(i + 1).trim();
234         lang = lang.substring(0, i).trim();
235      }
236      return new Locale(lang, country);
237   }

267   /**
268    * Constructor.
269    */
270   @SuppressWarnings({
271      "java:S112" // throws Exception intentional - callback/lifecycle method
272   })
273   RestRequest(RestOpContext opContext, RestSession session) throws Exception {
274      super(session.getRequest());
275      this.session = session;
276      this.opContext = opContext;
277
278      inner = session.getRequest();
279      context = session.getContext();
280
281      attrs = new RequestAttributes(this);
282
283      queryParams = new RequestQueryParamList(this, session.getQueryParams(), true);
284
285      headers = new RequestHeaderList(this, queryParams, false);
286
287      content = new RequestContent(this);
288
289      if (context.isAllowContentParam() && isContentParamMethod(inner.getMethod())) {
290         var b = queryParams.get("content").asString().orElse(null);
291         if (b != null) {
292            headers.set("Content-Type", UonSerializer.DEFAULT.getResponseContentType());
293            content.mediaType(MediaType.UON).parser(UonParser.DEFAULT).content(b.getBytes(UTF8));
294         }
295      }
296
297      pathParams = new RequestPathParamList(session, this, true);
298
299      marshallingSession = opContext.getMarshallingContext().getSession();
300
301      partParserSession = opContext.getPartParser().getPartSession();
302
303      pathParams.parser(partParserSession);
304
305      // @formatter:off
306      queryParams
307         .addDefault(opContext.getDefaultRequestQueryData().getAll())
308         .parser(partParserSession);
309
310      headers
311         .addDefault(opContext.getDefaultRequestHeaders().getAll())
312         .addDefault(context.getDefaultRequestHeaders().getAll())
313         .parser(partParserSession);
314
315      content
316         .encoders(opContext.getEncoders())
317         .parsers(opContext.getParsers())
318         .maxInput(opContext.getMaxInput());
319
320      attrs
321         .addDefault(opContext.getDefaultRequestAttributes())
322         .addDefault(context.getDefaultRequestAttributes());
323      // @formatter:on
324
325      if (isDebug())
326         inner = CachingHttpServletRequest.wrap(inner);
327   }

429   /**
430    * Evaluates the conditional-request headers on this request against the response's currently-set
431    * <c>ETag</c> and <c>Last-Modified</c> values.
432    *
433    * <p>
434    * Implements the precondition-evaluation order defined by
435    * <a class='doclink' href='https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7232#section-6'>RFC 7232 §6</a>:
436    * <ol>
437    *    <li><c>If-Match</c> — strong comparison; returns <c>412 Precondition Failed</c> on mismatch.
438    *    <li><c>If-Unmodified-Since</c> — only consulted when <c>If-Match</c> is absent;
439    *       returns <c>412 Precondition Failed</c> when the response's <c>Last-Modified</c> is
440    *       strictly after the supplied date.
441    *    <li><c>If-None-Match</c> — weak comparison; returns <c>304 Not Modified</c> on match
442    *       (for safe methods, per RFC 7232 §6).
443    *    <li><c>If-Modified-Since</c> — only consulted when <c>If-None-Match</c> is absent;
444    *       returns <c>304 Not Modified</c> when the response's <c>Last-Modified</c> is at-or-before
445    *       the supplied date.
446    * </ol>
447    *
448    * <h5 class='section'>Usage:</h5>
449    *
450    * <p>
451    * Set the response's <c>ETag</c> and/or <c>Last-Modified</c> <b>first</b>, then call this method.
452    * The check reads the headers currently on the response, so any value set after the call is not
453    * considered.
454    *
455    * <p class='bjava'>
456    *    <ja>@RestGet</ja>(<js>"/{id}"</js>)
457    *    <jk>public</jk> Order get(<ja>@Path</ja> <jk>long</jk> <jv>id</jv>, RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) {
458    *       <jk>var</jk> <jv>order</jv> = <jv>repo</jv>.find(<jv>id</jv>);
459    *       <jv>res</jv>.eTag(<js>"\""</js> + <jv>order</jv>.version() + <js>"\""</js>).lastModified(<jv>order</jv>.updated());
460    *       <jv>req</jv>.checkPreconditions(<jv>res</jv>).ifPresent(<jv>e</jv> -&gt; { <jk>throw</jk> <jv>e</jv>; });
461    *       <jk>return</jk> <jv>order</jv>;
462    *    }
463    * </p>
464    *
465    * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
466    *    <li class='note'>Returns an {@link Optional} so the caller controls how to handle the failure
467    *       (throw inline, hand off to a logger, etc.). Both the returned <c>304</c> and <c>412</c>
468    *       failures are {@link BasicHttpException} instances, which are {@link RuntimeException}s,
469    *       so {@code ifPresent(e -&gt; { throw e; })} compiles cleanly.
470    *    <li class='note'><c>If-None-Match: *</c> matches any present <c>ETag</c>; <c>If-Match: *</c>
471    *       fails only when no <c>ETag</c> is set on the response.
472    *    <li class='note'>Per RFC 7232 §3.1, <c>If-Match</c> requires strong comparison: a weak
473    *       <c>ETag</c> on the response side never satisfies an <c>If-Match</c>.
474    *    <li class='note'>Per RFC 7232 §3.2, <c>If-None-Match</c> uses weak comparison: the weak/strong
475    *       flag is ignored when comparing tag values.
476    * </ul>
477    *
478    * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
479    *    <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#eTag(String) RestResponse.eTag(String)}
480    *    <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#lastModified(Instant) RestResponse.lastModified(Instant)}
481    * </ul>
482    *
483    * @param response The response carrying the resource's current <c>ETag</c> and/or <c>Last-Modified</c>.
484    *    Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
485    * @return Empty if all preconditions pass; otherwise an {@link Optional} holding either a
486    *    <c>304 Not Modified</c> {@link BasicHttpException} (when the request's cache copy is still
487    *    fresh) or a {@link PreconditionFailed} (when an <c>If-Match</c> / <c>If-Unmodified-Since</c>
488    *    guard failed).
489    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code response} is <jk>null</jk>.
490    */
491   @SuppressWarnings({
492      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for HTTP precondition checks (If-Match, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since, etc.)
493   })
494   public Optional<BasicHttpException> checkPreconditions(RestResponse response) {
495      assertArgNotNull("response", response);
496      var resTagStr = response.getHeader(ETag.NAME);
497      var resTag = nn(resTagStr) ? EntityTag.of(resTagStr) : null;
498      var resLastModStr = response.getHeader(LastModified.NAME);
499      var resLastMod = nn(resLastModStr) ? parseHttpDate(resLastModStr) : null;
500
501      // RFC 7232 §6 step 1: If-Match (strong comparison; 412 on failure).
502      var ifMatch = getHeaderParam(IfMatch.NAME).orElse(null);
503      if (nn(ifMatch)) {
504         if (! matchesAnyStrong(EntityTags.of(ifMatch), resTag))
505            return o(preconditionFailed(IfMatch.NAME));
506      } else {
507         // RFC 7232 §6 step 2: If-Unmodified-Since (only when If-Match absent).
508         var ius = getHeaderParam(IfUnmodifiedSince.NAME).orElse(null);
509         if (nn(ius)) {
510            var iusDate = parseHttpDate(ius);
511            if (nn(iusDate) && nn(resLastMod) && resLastMod.toInstant().isAfter(iusDate.toInstant()))
512               return o(preconditionFailed(IfUnmodifiedSince.NAME));
513         }
514      }
515
516      // RFC 7232 §6 step 3: If-None-Match (weak comparison; 304 on match for safe methods).
517      var ifNoneMatch = getHeaderParam(IfNoneMatch.NAME).orElse(null);
518      if (nn(ifNoneMatch)) {
519         if (matchesAnyWeak(EntityTags.of(ifNoneMatch), resTag))
520            return o(notModified());
521      } else {
522         // RFC 7232 §6 step 4: If-Modified-Since (only when If-None-Match absent; only for GET/HEAD).
523         if (isSafeMethod()) {
524            var ims = getHeaderParam(IfModifiedSince.NAME).orElse(null);
525            if (nn(ims)) {
526               var imsDate = parseHttpDate(ims);
527               if (nn(imsDate) && nn(resLastMod) && ! resLastMod.toInstant().isAfter(imsDate.toInstant()))
528                  return o(notModified());
529            }
530         }
531      }
532
533      return oe();
534   }
535
536   private boolean isSafeMethod() {
537      var m = getMethod();
538      return "GET".equalsIgnoreCase(m) || "HEAD".equalsIgnoreCase(m);
539   }
540
541   // Package-private (rather than private) so RestRequest_Test can exercise these branches directly --
542   // this module cannot depend on MockRestClient (see RestArgResolvers_Test's note), so an HTTP-level
543   // integration test (see juneau-integration-tests' RestRequest_CheckPreconditions_Test) can't reach every
544   // sub-branch of these pure comparison helpers without an impractical combinatorial explosion of fixtures.
545   static ZonedDateTime parseHttpDate(String value) {
546      try {
547         return ZonedDateTime.from(RFC_1123_DATE_TIME.parse(value)).truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.SECONDS);
548      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") DateTimeParseException e) {
549         return null;
550      }
551   }
552
553   static boolean matchesAnyStrong(EntityTags clientTags, EntityTag resTag) {
554      if (clientTags == null)  // HTT: unreachable -- both call sites pass EntityTags.of(String), which never returns null.
555         return false;  // HTT: unreachable -- see enclosing if.
556      for (var t : clientTags.toArray()) {
557         if (t.isAny())
558            return resTag != null;
559         // Strong comparison: both sides must be strong AND opaque-tag values must be equal.
560         if (! t.isWeak() && resTag != null && ! resTag.isWeak() && eq(t.getEntityValue(), resTag.getEntityValue()))
561            return true;
562      }
563      return false;
564   }
565
566   static boolean matchesAnyWeak(EntityTags clientTags, EntityTag resTag) {
567      if (clientTags == null)  // HTT: unreachable -- both call sites pass EntityTags.of(String), which never returns null.
568         return false;  // HTT: unreachable -- see enclosing if.
569      for (var t : clientTags.toArray()) {
570         if (t.isAny())
571            return resTag != null;
572         // Weak comparison: opaque-tag values must be equal; weak/strong flag is ignored.
573         if (resTag != null && eq(t.getEntityValue(), resTag.getEntityValue()))
574            return true;
575      }
576      return false;
577   }

669    * Returns the URI authority portion of the request.
670    *
671    * @return The URI authority portion of the request.
672    */
673   public String getAuthorityPath() {
674      if (authorityPath == null)
675         authorityPath = context.getUriAuthority();
676      if (authorityPath == null) {
677         var scheme = inner.getScheme();
678         var port = inner.getServerPort();
679         var sb = new StringBuilder(inner.getScheme()).append("://").append(inner.getServerName());
680         if (! (port == 80 && "http".equals(scheme) || port == 443 && "https".equals(scheme)))
681            sb.append(':').append(port);
682         authorityPath = sb.toString();
683      }
684      return authorityPath;
685   }

694   /**
695    * Returns the charset specified on the <c>Content-Type</c> header, or <js>"UTF-8"</js> if not specified.
696    *
697    * @return The charset to use to decode the request content.
698    */
699   public Charset getCharset() {
700      if (charset == null) {
701         // Determine charset
702         // NOTE:  Don't use super.getCharacterEncoding() because the spec is implemented inconsistently.
703         // Jetty returns the default charset instead of null if the character is not specified on the request.
704         var h = getHeaderParam("Content-Type").orElse(null);
705         if (nn(h)) {
706            var i = h.indexOf(";charset=");
707            if (i > 0)
708               charset = Charset.forName(h.substring(i + 9).trim());
709         }
710         if (charset == null)
711            charset = opContext.getDefaultCharset();
712         if (charset == null)
713            charset = StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
714      }
715      return charset;
716   }

1051   /**
1052    * Returns the preferred Locale that the client will accept content in, based on the Accept-Language header.
1053    *
1054    * <p>
1055    * If the client request doesn't provide an <c>Accept-Language</c> header, this method returns the default locale for the server.
1056    *
1057    * @return The preferred Locale that the client will accept content in.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
1058    */
1059   @Override
1060   public Locale getLocale() {
1061      var best = inner.getLocale();
1062      var h = headers.get("Accept-Language").asString().orElse(null);
1063      if (nn(h)) {
1064         var sr = StringRanges.of(h);
1065         float qValue = 0;
1066         for (var r : sr.toList()) {
1067            if (r.getQValue() > qValue) {
1068               best = toLocale(r.getName());
1069               qValue = r.getQValue();
1070            }
1071         }
1072      }
1073      return best;
1074   }

1319   /**

1321    *

1323    * <p class='bjava'>
1324    *    <ja>@RestPost</ja>(<js>"/mypath/{p1}/{p2}/*"</js>)
1325    *    <jk>public void</jk> myMethod(<ja>@Request</ja> MyRequest <jv>requestBean</jv>) {...}
1326    *
1327    *    <jk>public interface</jk> MyRequest {
1328    *
1329    *       <ja>@Path</ja> <jc>// Path variable name inferred from getter.</jc>
1330    *       String getP1();
1331    *
1332    *       <ja>@Path</ja>(<js>"p2"</js>)
1333    *       String getX();
1334    *
1335    *       <ja>@Path</ja>(<js>"/*"</js>)
1336    *       String getRemainder();
1337    *
1338    *       <ja>@Query</ja>
1339    *       String getQ1();
1340    *
1341    *    <jc>// Schema-based query parameter:  Pipe-delimited lists of comma-delimited lists of integers.</jc>
1342    *       <ja>@Query</ja>(
1343    *          collectionFormat=<js>"pipes"</js>
1344    *          items=<ja>@Items</ja>(
1345    *             items=<ja>@SubItems</ja>(
1346    *                collectionFormat=<js>"csv"</js>
1347    *                type=<js>"integer"</js>
1348    *             )
1349    *          )
1350    *       )
1351    *       <jk>int</jk>[][] getQ3();
1352    *
1353    *       <ja>@Header</ja>(<js>"*"</js>)
1354    *       Map&lt;String,Object&gt; getHeaders();
1355    * </p>
1356    *
1357    * @param <T> The request bean interface to instantiate.
1358    * @param c The request bean interface to instantiate.
1359    * @return A new request bean proxy for this REST request.
1360    */
1361   public <T> T getRequest(Class<T> c) {
1362      return getRequest(RequestBeanMeta.create(c, getContext().getAnnotations()));
1363   }

1365   /**
1366    * Same as {@link #getRequest(Class)} but used on pre-instantiated {@link RequestBeanMeta} objects.
1367    *
1368    * @param <T> The request bean interface to instantiate.
1369    * @param rbm The metadata about the request bean interface to create.
1370    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1371    * @return A new request bean proxy for this REST request.
1372    */
1373   @SuppressWarnings({
1374      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for request bean mapping logic
1375   })
1376   public <T> T getRequest(RequestBeanMeta rbm) {
1377      try {
1378         var c = (Class<T>)rbm.getBeanInfo().inner();
1379         final MarshallingSession bs = getMarshallingSession();
1380         final BeanMeta<T> bm = bs.getBeanMeta(c);
1381         return (T)Proxy.newProxyInstance(c.getClassLoader(), a(c), (InvocationHandler)(proxy, method, args) -> {
1382            RequestBeanPropertyMeta pm = rbm.getProperty(method.getName());
1383            if (nn(pm)) {
1384               HttpPartParserSession pp = pm.getParser(getPartParserSession());
1385               HttpPartSchema schema = pm.getSchema();
1386               String name = pm.getPartName();
1387               var type = bs.getClassMeta(method.getGenericReturnType());
1388               HttpPartType pt = pm.getPartType();
1389               if (pt == HttpPartType.BODY)
1390                  return getContent().setSchema(schema).as(type);
1391               if (pt == QUERY)
1392                  return getQueryParam(name).parser(pp).schema(schema).as(type).orElse(null);
1393               if (pt == FORMDATA)
1394                  return getFormParam(name).parser(pp).schema(schema).as(type).orElse(null);
1395               if (pt == HEADER)
1396                  return getHeaderParam(name).parser(pp).schema(schema).as(type).orElse(null);
1397               if (pt == PATH)  // HTT: always true here -- RequestBeanMeta.Builder only ever creates properties typed BODY/QUERY/FORMDATA/HEADER/PATH, and the prior 4 branches already excluded the first 4, so PATH is the only value left.
1398                  return getPathParam(name).parser(pp).schema(schema).as(type).orElse(null);
1399            }
1400            return null;
1401         });
1402      } catch (Exception e) {
1403         throw toRex(e);
1404      }
1405   }

1417      return HttpRequestLineBean.of(inner.getMethod(), inner.getRequestURI(), pv);

1497   /**

1503    * URI).

1515         if (nn(addQueryParams))

1517               rq.set(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
1518         if (! rq.isEmpty())

1520         uri = sb.toString();
1521      }
1522      try {
1523         return new URI(uri);
1524      } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
1525         // Shouldn't happen.

1899   @SafeVarargs
1900   private static Map<String,Object> mergeSessionMaps(Map<String,Object>...maps) {
1901      Map<String,Object> result = null;
1902      for (var map : maps) {
1903         if (ine(map)) {
1904            if (result == null)
1905               result = new LinkedHashMap<>(map);
1906            else
1907               result.putAll(map);
1908         }
1909      }
1910      return result != null ? u(result) : Collections.emptyMap();
1911   }

1921   private static Map<String,Object> parseUonMap(String input, Consumer<ParseException> onError) {
1922      try {
1923         var m = Uon.to(input, JsonMap.class);
1924         return m != null ? m : Collections.emptyMap();
1925      } catch (ParseException e) {
1926         onError.accept(e);  // HTT: both call sites' onError always throws via badRequest(), so JaCoCo never sees this call complete normally.
1927         return Collections.emptyMap();  // HTT: unreachable in practice -- see onError.accept(e) above.
1928      }
1929   }

2014   @Override /* Overridden from Object */
2015   public String toString() {
2016      var sb = new StringBuilder("\n").append(getRequestLine()).append("\n");
2017      sb.append("---Headers---\n");
2018      getHeaders().forEach(x -> sb.append("\t").append(x).append("\n"));
2019      var m = getMethod();
2020      if (m.equals("PUT") || m.equals("POST")) {
2021         try {
2022            sb.append("---Content UTF-8---\n");
2023            sb.append(content.asString()).append("\n");
2024            sb.append("---Content Hex---\n");
2025            sb.append(content.asSpacedHex()).append("\n");
2026         } catch (Exception e1) {
2027            sb.append(localizedMessage(e1));
2028         }
2029      }
2030      return sb.toString();
2031   }
